content.title: Razorback - Definition, Meaning & Synonyms
content.text: Definitions of razorback noun a mongrel hog with a thin body and long legs and a ridged back; a wild or semi-wild descendant of improved breeds; found chiefly in the southeastern United States see moresee less type of: swinestout-bodied short-legged omnivorous animals noun any of several baleen whales of the family Balaenopteridae having longitudinal grooves on the throat and a small pointed dorsal fin adjective having a sharp narrow back “razorback hogs” backedhaving a back or backing, usually of a specified type "Razorback."
